First bail application of the applicant was rejected on 16.05.2023 vide Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.22994 of 2020.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
It is submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 24.11.2019.
After the rejection of first bail application of the applicant four prosecution witnesses have been examined so far.
There is no chance of tempering the witnesses since the witnesses of fact has been examined.
It is further submitted that in case applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.

The bail application is allowed.
